spells.name: Iban Blast
spells.notes: Requires Iban's staff (also uses 1 staff charge vs NPCs, 2 vs players). Elemental staves cannot supply the fire runes; a charged Tome of fire can.

spells.name: Saradomin Strike
spells.notes: 30 with Charge active and Saradomin cape worn. Requires Saradomin staff or Staff of light.

spells.name: Claws of Guthix
spells.notes: 30 with Charge active and Guthix cape worn. Requires Guthix staff, Void knight mace or Staff of balance.

spells.name: Flames of Zamorak
spells.notes: 30 with Charge active and Zamorak cape worn. Requires a Zamorak-aligned staff.

spells.name: Crumble Undead
spells.notes: Undead targets only. Wiki infobox lists no element.

spells.name: Inferior Demonbane
spells.notes: Demons only. No quest requirement.

spells.name: Superior Demonbane
spells.notes: Demons only. Requires A Kingdom Divided.

spells.name: Dark Demonbane
spells.notes: Demons only. Requires A Kingdom Divided.

spells.name: Ghostly Grasp
spells.notes: 10% bind chance (1.2s). No quest requirement.

spells.name: Skeletal Grasp
spells.notes: 25% bind chance (1.8s). Requires A Kingdom Divided.

spells.name: Undead Grasp
spells.notes: 50% bind chance. Requires A Kingdom Divided.

chargedWeapons.name: Trident of the seas
chargedWeapons.notes: Up to 2,500 charges; 1 charge per cast.

chargedWeapons.name: Trident of the swamp
chargedWeapons.notes: No coins; 1 Zulrah's scale instead. Up to 2,500 charges.

chargedWeapons.name: Eye of Ayak
chargedWeapons.notes: Charged with EITHER demon tears (1 per charge) OR runes (2 death + 1 chaos per charge); cannot hold both. Up to 50,000 charges.

chargedWeapons.name: Warped sceptre
chargedWeapons.notes: Up to 20,000 charges. Can be charged with combination runes.

chargedWeapons.name: Thammaron's sceptre
chargedWeapons.notes: Needs a 1,000-ether activation deposit (refunded on uncharge), then 1 ether per attack. The 'Swap' option turns it into Thammaron's sceptre (a), which autocasts standard spells and Ancients instead of using a built-in spell.

chargedWeapons.name: Accursed sceptre
chargedWeapons.notes: Same ether model as Thammaron's sceptre. Swap to Accursed sceptre (a) to autocast.

chargedWeapons.name: Iban's staff
chargedWeapons.notes: Not a powered staff. Iban Blast costs its normal runes (5 fire + 1 death) PLUS 1 staff charge (2 vs players). Staff charges refill free at the well in the Underground Pass; 120 charges, or 2,500 for Iban's staff (u). Elemental staves cannot supply the fire runes; a charged tome of fire can.

chargedWeapons.name: Dawnbringer
chargedWeapons.notes: Theatre of Blood only (Verzik phase 1). Uses no runes or charges and crumbles once the shield breaks.

chargedWeapons.name: Twinflame staff
chargedWeapons.notes: Not a powered staff. It autocasts standard spells and pays normal spell runes, but is an infinite source of fire AND water runes.

runeSources.notes: Only while it has at least 1 charge (burnt or searing pages). Non-combat casts use no charges; standard-spellbook fire combat spells use 1 charge each.
Only while charged with at least 1 soaked-page charge. Only standard-spellbook water combat spells use charges; Ice spells do not.
Only while charged with soiled pages. Only standard-spellbook earth combat spells use charges.
Not an infinite source. It stores up to 1,000 nature runes that count as carried, with a 1/15 chance to save one nature rune per cast. Provides no elemental runes.

Sunfire rune.notes: Can replace fire runes in any spell. Fire spells gain a minimum hit of 10% of max hit. Still consumed even when an infinite fire source is equipped.

autocastAncientsNotes: Ahrim's staff autocasts Ancients only with the full Ahrim's set and Amulet of the damned. Zuriel's staff (bh) has ancient=yes on its own page but is missing from the Autocast page table. Harmonised nightmare staff, Twinflame staff and elemental/combination staves are standard only.
autocastArceuusNotes: These cannot autocast Arceuus: Staff of light, Staff of balance, Ancient staff and sceptres, Nightmare staves, Dragon hunter wand, and Thammaron's/Accursed sceptre (a). Autocastable Arceuus spells are the 3 Demonbane and 3 Grasp spells.
